images.title: Walk from 250 to −100
images.purpose: Show that the move from 250 to −100 is 350 steps to the left, so 250 + ? = −100 gives ? = −350.
images.composition: One horizontal line across the middle with three marks and one long arrow above it, one equation centred below.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal line in grey #6B7280 with arrowheads at both ends and exactly 3 tick marks placed to scale: −100 at the left, 0, and 250 at the right, with 0 exactly 100 units from −100 and 250 exactly 250 units from 0. The 250 mark is teal #0072B2, the −100 mark is amber #E69F00. One long arrow in reddish purple #CC79A7 above the line from 250 to −100, pointing left, labelled 350 left. Exactly 3 marks, 1 arrow.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
extra tick marks or numbers on the line other than the three listed
images.takeaway: The move from the second number to the first is the missing part.
images.description: A line with marks at −100, 0 and 250 and a leftward arrow of 350 from 250 to −100.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the start and the end and say how far the arrow goes.

image_decisions.why: The missing move is a walk from one number to another; one long arrow carries it.
